steps: click "Vezi ca tabel" on the spend chart twice
findings.evidence: The flow read aria-expanded and counted the table straight after the second click, before Angular re-rendered. Its own screenshot (shots/flow-02-table-stuck.png) shows the table closed and only the "Vezi ca tabel" button left. libs/ui-cockpit/src/lib/chart.ts toggles with `(click)="tableShown.set(!tableShown())"` behind `@if (tableShown())`. No change needed.
